div.p:
IT is much to be regretted, that the Patronspatrons of Churcheschurches ſhouldshould be generally ſoso obnoxious to that odious Reproachreproach of the Sinsin of Simonysimony, wherein it is the Lotlot of the Innocentinnocent to ſuffersuffer with the Guiltyguilty. But that which hathhas given occaſionoccasion thereto, is, Thatthat the moſtmost of Patronspatrons have never ſeriouſlyseriously conſideredconsidered the nature or end of their Powerpower; and ſomesome have never look'dlooked upon it as a Mattermatter

Moreover, I warn you, as you would wiſhwish to avoid the Guiltguilt of the Bloodblood of Soulssouls, to conſiderconsider well whom you PreſentpresentPresent to have Chargecharge over them. Do not imagine to waſhwash your hands from this Guiltguilt, by that frivolous ExcuſeexcuseExcuse wherewith ſomesome flatter their own ConſciencesconsciencesConsciences, whilſtwhilewhilst they would ſhiftshift off the whole Burthenburden from themſelvesthemselves, upon the BiſhopsbishopsBishops and Governoursgovernors of the Churchchurch, ſayingsaying, Theythey are the only competent Judgesjudges of the Qualificationsqualifications of the PerſonspersonsPersons, whilſtwhilewhilst the Patronspatrons are no more concerned but to
